prompt: Create an original 120 second instrumental dub instrumental composition for travel montage, walking and urban exploration. Mood: moving, bright, relaxed. Instruments: round electric bass, organ, rimshot, echo guitar. Style: spacious offbeat chords with restrained tape delay. Tempo approximately 84 BPM; E minor. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use a forward-moving motif and recurring short instrumental answers. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: An upbeat and energetic instrumental track featuring a driving drum beat, prominent bassline, rhythmic electric guitars, and a melodic lead guitar with synth pads providing atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首欢快且充满活力的纯音乐，以强劲的鼓点、突出的贝斯线、有节奏的电吉他以及带有合成器衬垫营造氛围的旋律主音吉他为特色。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
